title: Phase 1 deferred fixes: store correctness, kith-tslocal hardening
description:
What: Resolve all deferred P1/P2 findings from Phase 1 review cycles.

Why: Phase 1 MVP (all 13 implementation epics) is complete. Before moving to Phase 2 features, correctness and security bugs from review cycles must be closed. Three categories:

1. kith-store correctness bugs (KITH-wa5, KITH-i2s, KITH-uhj, KITH-q7g, KITH-uos): atomicity violations, state regressions, security sign-flip — these affect real behavior.
2. kith-tslocal hardening (KITH-626.x P1/P2): size limits, null-byte validation, error message consistency, serde forward-compat, test coverage gaps — these affect robustness and maintainability.
3. Web client / kith-events (KITH-dwr, KITH-kv2): silent render failures, SSE coalescing.

Outcome: All P1/P2 open issues closed, workspace clean, cargo test passes.
